scripts.build: next build && node scripts/build-id.mjs && node scripts/gen-sw.mjs
scripts.//verify:inertia: Checks the inertia estimator against a simulated engine of known J. No test framework: Node 22 strips types natively, and ts-resolve.mjs supplies the extensionless-import resolution the bundler normally does.
scripts.//verify:tankvent: Checks the tank-ventilation channels: the three DS2 offsets, and that an absent TETV reading never becomes a "valve shut" claim. Same runner as verify:inertia.
scripts.//verify:tankvent-patch: Checks the K_TE_TVTE_GA patch at the byte level: exactly one byte moves, and turning it OFF restores stock rather than no-opping.
scripts.//verify:coverage: Checks the VE evidence gate: one sample no longer moves a cell, both conditions are required, and a REJECTED cell still reports the samples it has rather than 0.
scripts.//preview: Cloudflare Pages preview target — see wrangler.jsonc. Production is untouched: it stays on GitHub Pages from main.
scripts.preview: npm run build:preview && wrangler pages dev
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:preview && wrangler pages deploy --project-name mss54hp-tuner-preview --branch rf-korr
scripts.db:sessions: wrangler d1 execute mss54hp-tuner-runs --remote --command "SELECT id, datetime(synced_at/1000,'unixepoch') AS synced, label, status, point_count, has_tune, has_rf, has_egt FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.db:diagnostics: wrangler d1 execute mss54hp-tuner-runs --remote --command "SELECT datetime(created_at/1000,'unixepoch') AS at, kind, CASE completed WHEN 1 THEN 'ok' ELSE 'FAILED' END AS outcome, exchanges, elapsed_ms, baud, requested_baud, round(median_turnaround,1) AS turnaround, round(median_total,1) AS total, round(median_host_gap,1) AS host_gap, retries, CASE mock WHEN 1 THEN 'mock' ELSE transport END AS via, substr(coalesce(error,''),1,60) AS err, id FROM diagnostics ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30"
scripts.build:preview: next build && node scripts/brand-preview.mjs && node scripts/embed-sync-token.mjs && node scripts/build-id.mjs && node scripts/gen-sw.mjs
